synthesis:draft.headline: TOTALDEMAND is the NEMDE-calculated regional demand measure at the Regional Reference Node used in DISPATCHREGIONSUM.

document_statements.paraphrase: Total Demand is the forecast demand at the Regional Reference Node that is met by local scheduled and semi-scheduled generation plus interconnector imports, excluding local scheduled loads and allocated interconnector losses, and including demand met by Wholesale Demand Response. [aemo_demand_terms#p21c42]

document_statements.quote: TotalDemand = Sum of InitialMW Over all Regional Scheduled and Semi-scheduled generating units – Sum of InitialMW Over all Regional Scheduled Loads + Sum of InitialMW Over all Regional Scheduled BDUs

document_statements.paraphrase: In the DISPATCHREGIONSUM table the TOTALDEMAND field is documented as the region-level demand (less loads) provided for each five-minute dispatch solution. [mms_dm_elec22#DISPATCHREGIONSUM#0]
